templates.title: Ente Photos

templates.description: Ente is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted platform to store, share, and rediscover your photos and videos across all your devices.

env.label: ENTE_API_ORIGIN

env.name: ENTE_APPS_PUBLIC_ALBUMS

env.label: ENTE_JWT_SECRET
env.description: JWT signing secret. Rotate before real use.
